mapper.select: SELECT /* homes.buld.mapper.BuldMapper.getTitleLedgrChngSeq 변경일련번호 조회 */ COUNT(1) + 1 AS CHNG_SEQ FROM TB_HBD_TITLE_LEDGR_HIST WHERE BULD_REGSTR_PK = #{buldno}
SELECT /* homes.buld.mapper.BuldMapper.getLedgrPpsHistno 용도변경 일련번호 조회 */ NVL(MAX(HISTNO), 0) + 1 AS HISTNO FROM TB_BD_TITLE_LEDGR_PPS_HIST A WHERE A.BULD_REGSTR_PK = #{buldno}
